name: report_fixes
description: Report a verdict for every finding and the edits for every string with a finding to fix. Call exactly once.

strings.description: One entry per string in the batch.

ref.description: The string's number as given in the batch.

edits.description: Literal replacements that remove every defect judged `fix`. Empty when nothing is fixed.

find.description: Text copied exactly from the translation, not touching any placeholder or markup.

occurrences.description: How many times `find` appears in the whole string. All of them are replaced.

findings.description: One verdict per finding raised against this string.

reason.description: One sentence. For false_positive, why the translation is correct, in terms a reviewer can check.
